_source: rsprox 226/01637, 226/01671 (Bob Barter), 226/01671, 232/03238, 238/04168 (Murky Matt) and 230/00333 (Zahur, the same decant interface); the Wiki (Bob Barter (herbs), Murky Matt (runes), Decanting).
_zahur: Zahur's Decant opens the same interface and speaks his lines (rsprox 230/00333: opnpc3 on elid_herbalist, then decant 582).
_buttons: decant_1 .. decant_4 (582:3-6), recorded for Zahur; Bob's own clicks were all decant_4 (582:6).
_vialPrice: Wiki (Decanting): a vial Bob has to supply costs 5 coins.
_cup: Wiki (Bob Barter (herbs)): "He will also decant Guthix rests"; Guthix rest (Wiki): two (3)s give a (4) and a (2). Emptied ones come back as empty cups; a cup he supplies costs its Grand Exchange price plus 2 (Wiki, Bob Barter (herbs) and Zahur): 3 + 2 = 5 by item-prices.json, the same as a vial.
_jewellery: Charges pooled per family up to its normal capacity (recorded: dueling 8, glory 4, skills 4; Wiki: not past it, as for a Fountain of Rune glory(6)). `empty`: what an emptied piece becomes (recorded: glory and skills necklaces come back uncharged; dueling rings are gone). `fountain`: the Fountain of Rune can charge it further.
_messages: All recorded except nothingToDecant (Zahur's line for the same interface, 230/00333) and poor/poorCups (mine). Bob's recorded lead-in ("Let's see what you have...") opens and is replaced by the result on the same tick, so only the result is shown.

messages.short: You're a bit short of inventory space.
messages.nothingToDecant: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
messages.poor: You'll need some coins for the vials I'd have to give you.
messages.poorCups: You'll need some coins for the cups I'd have to give you.
messages.nothingToCombine: Arrr, ye've got nothing that I can combine.
messages.fountain: Arrr, ye've nothing I can combine. Maybe ye needs to take yer stuff up to the Wilderness and charge it on the Fountain of Rune. It be more powerful than me.
